name: frigate
title: Frigate NVR
description: Frigate, the open-source NVR with real-time object detection for IP cameras. Deploys with a starter config and no cameras: add them in Frigate (Settings → Configuration editor) or in App-Data/Frigate/config/config.yml, restart, and read the first admin password from the container logs. A Coral TPU or GPU makes detection cheap; see the config comments.

variables.name: PORT_FRIGATE_RTSP
variables.label: RTSP restream port
variables.description: Frigate restreams cameras on this port

variables.name: PORT_FRIGATE_WEBRTC
variables.label: WebRTC port
variables.description: TCP and UDP, for live view in the browser

variables.name: FRIGATE_MEDIA_PATH
variables.label: Recordings path
variables.description: Host directory for recordings and snapshots (grows fast — use a big disk)

variables.name: FRIGATE_RTSP_PASSWORD
variables.label: Camera password
variables.description: Available in config.yml as {FRIGATE_RTSP_PASSWORD} so camera passwords never sit in the file

variables.name: FRIGATE_SHM_SIZE
variables.label: Shared memory
variables.description: Roughly 30 MB + 10 MB per camera at 720p; raise for many or 4K cameras

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
